name: CausalDynamics Benchmark
model_or_instrument: dysts ODE/SDE systems, GNR scale-free DAGs, XRO ENSO model, and qgs (MAOOAM) atmosphere-ocean model
size_as_stated: over 14000 graphs and over 50 million preprocessed samples
resolution: 1000 time steps per trajectory, 5 trajectories per graph

scales.note: Idealized and reduced-order dynamical systems; time is non-dimensional steps (1000 steps per trajectory) without physical spatial grid.
